condition: Private open space at ground level; minimum dimension of 3 metres is stated in the same clause.
source_text:
Private open space at the ground level is to have a minimum area of 16sqm
and minimum dimension of 3m.

condition: On lots smaller than 150 square metres, a secondary dwelling is only permitted if the principal dwelling retains this minimum consolidated private open space (with a minimum dimension of 3m, stated in the same clause); this is the same figure as the general dwelling-house control in 4.1.3.5.
source_text:
On lots smaller than 150sqm, a secondary dwelling is not permitted unless
it can achieve a minimum consolidated area of private open space for the
principal dwelling of 16sqm with a minimum dimension of 3m.

condition: Ground level dwellings only; minimum dimension of 4 metres is stated in the same clause; consolidated area required for all dwelling sizes within a development.
source_text: (a) ground level dwellings: 25sqm with a minimum dimension of 4m; and

condition: Upper level units only; minimum dimension of 2 metres is stated in the same clause; consolidated area required for all dwelling sizes within a development.
source_text: (b) upper level units: 10sqm with a minimum dimension of 2m.

condition: Applies to 30% of all bedrooms in a boarding house; private open space to be in the form of a balcony or terrace area.
source_text:
(5) 30% of all bedrooms are to have access to private open space with a
minimum area of 4sqm in the form of a balcony or terrace area.

condition: Epsom Park precinct (Section 5.3); minimum depth of the ground floor private open space deck for ground/first floor apartments, from the Figure 5.87 legend (item 3). The same figure separately shows a maximum height of 1m above street level for the same deck - that is a different attribute, not this control.
source_text: 3. Ground floor private open space deck – min. 1.2m

condition: Ashmore precinct (Section 5.5); typical ground floor residential flat building condition, Figure 5.150, item (3). Item (6) in the same list gives a separate maximum of 1 metre above street level for the same deck - not this control.
source_text: (3) Ground floor private open space deck - minimum 1.2 metre;

condition: North Rosebery precinct (Section 5.7); typical ground floor condition for residential development, Figure 5.189, item 3. Item 6 in the same figure gives a separate maximum of 1m above street level for the same deck - not this control.
source_text: 3. Ground floor private open space deck - min. 1.2m

condition: Specific-site figures (Section 6.2) for the Hurley Street interface with the adjoining site (Figure 6.38) and the Huntley Street frontage (Figure 6.39); both give the same minimum ground floor private open space deck depth.
source_text: 3. Ground floor private open space deck - min. 1.2m

condition: Specific-site figure (Section 6.2) for the Sydney Park Road frontage, Figure 6.40 - a different minimum depth (1.5m) than the other frontages of the same site.
source_text: 3. Ground floor private open space deck - min. 1.5m

condition: Contiguous, provided at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling; minimum dimension of 6 metres is stated in the same clause; open space within the front setback is excluded from this calculation (C.05 of the same section).
source_text:
A minimum 100m² of private open space must be provided for each dwelling. This space is to
be contiguous, provided at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling, and have a
minimum dimension of 6 metres.

condition: Contiguous, at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling, with direct access from internal living spaces; minimum dimension of 6 metres is stated in the same clause.
source_text:
A minimum 100m² of private open space must be provided for each dwelling. Private open
space must be contiguous, at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling, allow direct
access from internal living spaces, and have a minimum dimension of 6 metres.

condition: May be provided as a patio or balcony.
source_text:
A minimum 12m² of private open space must be associated with a secondary dwelling. This may
be provided as a patio or balcony.

condition: Townhouses (Section 3.4.1, Multi-Dwelling Housing); contiguous, provided at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling; minimum dimension of 5 metres is stated in the same clause; open space within the street setback is excluded from this calculation (C.04 of the same section).
source_text:
A minimum 40m² of private open space must be provided for each dwelling. This space is to be
contiguous, provided at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling, and have a minimum
dimension of 5 metres.

condition: Terraces (Section 3.4.2, Multi-Dwelling Housing); contiguous, provided at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling; minimum dimension of 5 metres and the exclusion of street-setback open space are stated in the same clause.
source_text:
A minimum 40m² of private open space must be provided for each dwelling. This space is to be
contiguous, provided at ground level, located to the rear of each dwelling, and have a minimum
dimension of 5 metres. Open space within the street setback is not included in the minimum
private open space area calculation.

condition: Ground floor apartments/dwellings within multi dwelling housing; minimum dimension of 2 metres also required.
source_text:
C.03 For apartments at ground level, a minimum private open space area of 15m² is to be provided
with a minimum dimension of 2 metres.

condition: First-floor level dwellings within multi dwelling housing, 1-bedroom or studio units; minimum dimension of 2 metres also required (DCP 3.4.3 C.04).
source_text: a) 1-bedroom/studio units must provide a minimum of 8m² per dwelling.

condition: First-floor level dwellings within multi dwelling housing, 2-bedroom units; minimum dimension of 2 metres also required (DCP 3.4.3 C.04).
source_text: b) 2-bedroom units must provide a minimum of 12m² per dwellings.

condition: First-floor level dwellings within multi dwelling housing, 3 or more-bedroom units; minimum dimension of 2 metres also required (DCP 3.4.3 C.04).
source_text: c) 3 or more-bedroom units must provide a minimum of 16m² per dwelling.

condition: Apartment buildings, per dwelling, 1-bedroom/studio units; contiguous area with a minimum dimension of 2 metres (DCP 3.5.1 C.08).
source_text: a) 1-bedroom/studio units must provide a minimum of 8m² per dwelling.

condition: Apartment buildings, per dwelling, 2-bedroom units; contiguous area with a minimum dimension of 2 metres (DCP 3.5.1 C.08).
source_text: b) 2-bedroom units must provide a minimum of 12m² per dwellings.

condition: Apartment buildings, per dwelling, 3 or more-bedroom units; contiguous area with a minimum dimension of 2 metres (DCP 3.5.1 C.08).
source_text: c) 3 or more-bedroom units must provide a minimum of 16m² per dwelling.

condition: Applies only to the private open space adjacent to an on-site manager's accommodation within a boarding house (not to general boarding house rooms); minimum dimension 2.5 metres; must be located other than in the front setback area.
source_text:
C.48 If accommodation is provided for an on-site manager, one area of at least 8m² with a minimum
dimension of 2.5 metres is to be provided adjacent to that accommodation, other than in the
front setback area.

condition: Epping Strategic Centre, shop top housing; ground level apartments (overrides the bedroom-based rate above); table also states a minimum width of 3 metres.
source_text: Ground level apartments 15m2 3m

condition: Newington Local Centre precinct; detached family dwelling on a standard lot, with direct access to the living area. The same 25m² minimum is also stated for the detached family dwelling on a zipper lot and for the single- and two-storey courtyard dwelling types in this precinct (DCP 8.2.5.3.4).
section_ref: DETACHED FAMILY DWELLING – STANDARD LOT, C.02
source_text:
Minimum 25m² shall be required as private open space with direct
access to living area.

condition: Newington Local Centre precinct; terrace house (attached dwelling), north to the street, with direct access to living areas.
section_ref: TERRACE HOUSE – NORTH TO THE STREET, C.02
source_text:
Minimum 25m² shall be required as private open space with direct
access to living areas.

condition: Newington Local Centre precinct; town house (semi-detached), south to the street, with direct access to living area.
section_ref: TOWN HOUSE (SOUTH TO THE STREET), C.09
source_text:
Minimum 25m² shall be required as private open space with direct
access to living area.

condition: Newington Local Centre, residential flat buildings; above-ground-floor level, for a balcony; minimum width 1.8 metres. The same figure is restated at C.20.
source_text:
C.03 The above ground floor level shall have a 7m² minimum area of private open space for a
balcony and a minimum width of 1.8 metres.

condition: Newington Local Centre, residential flat buildings; ground floor level, per dwelling; minimum dimension 3 metres. The same figure is restated at C.19.
source_text:
C.04 The ground floor level shall have 10m² minimum area of private open space per dwelling and a
minimum dimension of 3 metres.

condition: Carlingford Local Centre precinct; each apartment at ground level; minimum dimension 4 metres.
source_text:
C.14 The minimum area of private open space for each apartment at ground level must be 25m².
The minimum dimension is 4 metres.

condition: Carlingford Local Centre precinct; dwellings above ground level, balcony or terrace; minimum depth 2 metres.
source_text:
C.15 In order to provide useable open space to dwellings above ground level, any balcony or terrace
shall have a minimum area of 10m² and a minimum depth of 2 metres.

condition: Hunterford Estate, Oatlands precinct (small lot/integrated housing scheme); applies to all dwellings EXCEPT residential flat buildings, at a site density of 40 dwellings per hectare or less; minimum dimension 3 metres; maximum gradient 1 in 10.
section_ref: For all dwellings (except residential flat buildings) with a site density of 40 dwellings per ha or less, item a)
source_text:
The minimum private open space area required is 20% of the site area, with a minimum
dimension of 3 metres.

condition: Hunterford Estate, Oatlands precinct (small lot/integrated housing scheme); applies to all dwellings EXCEPT residential flat buildings, at a site density of more than 40 dwellings per hectare (minimum 20% of site area where density exceeds 60 dwellings/ha); minimum dimension 2.5 metres. One part of this space must be an area of 16m² with a minimum dimension of 4 metres, directly accessible from a living area of the dwelling.
section_ref: For all dwellings (except residential flat buildings) with a site density more than 40 dwellings per ha, item a)
source_text:
Dwellings should be provided with a total minimum area of 35m² (minimum 20% of the site
area for site densities greater than 60 dwellings per ha), with a minimum dimension of 2.5
metres.
